findings.statement: The 2 x 2 x 2 protocol is a future preregistration, not an executed study: it has no held-out cases, paired repetitions, randomized order receipt, per-trial outcomes, or confidence intervals.
findings.defect_hypothesis: Fixture-development results or a point estimate could be used as a component-benefit or comparative conclusion without the prespecified denominator and uncertainty analysis.
findings.impact: No component effect, default-adoption decision, comparator result, or SOTA conclusion is estimable from P0-P4.
findings.safety_red_line: Do not promote a component or comparator from a non-held-out, unpaired, or post hoc result.
findings.limitation: No live-model or chemistry-engine trial is authorized by this review packet, so the missing experimental data cannot be manufactured by review.
